source_review.notes: Checked official JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Core, Validation, and release notes for resources, $id, $ref, $defs, dynamic scope, annotations, and bundling; authoritative OpenAPI 3.2.0 Components, Reference, and Schema Objects; and RFC 3986 plus RFC 6901 URI and pointer foundations.

evidence: Reviewed dependency graph G=(C,E), direct fan-in, reverse-reachable impact, path notation, and semantic-contract condition against the prose.
notation_and_syntax.notes: All symbols and set directions are introduced correctly, and automated GitHub-math diagnostics report no issue.

evidence: Executed the component graph audit and recomputed four reachable components, three component-to-component edges plus two operation-root edges, maximum fan-in two, and zero unresolved targets.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The initial expected edge count was corrected from four to five during review; the executable output now matches the graph definition.

evidence: Checked reverse dependency reach, fan-in interpretation, allOf as intersection, typed namespace separation, and semantic equivalence as distinct from syntactic equality.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Graph metrics are labeled review signals rather than proofs of sound semantic reuse.

evidence: Reviewed false semantic friends, direction mismatch, wrong component namespace, unresolved and relative references, nested $id bases, closed-base extension, overlapping unions, recursion depth, accidental cycles, dead components, high fan-in, mutable registry aliases, and identity-losing bundles.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Authoring, resolution, evaluation, generation, registry, and consumer compatibility boundaries are all covered.

evidence: Checked semantic equivalence, single ownership, typed targets, canonical identity, directional integrity, correct applicator semantics, bounded recursion, reachable publication, bundle equivalence, and transitive review across examples and answers.
invariant_checking.notes: No section equates textual duplication, component presence, high fan-in, or generated code with sound reuse.

proof_review.notes: No formal theorem or general compatibility proof is claimed.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No proof sketch is claimed; graph formulas are impact-analysis definitions.

evidence: The graph checker explicitly disclaims semantic reuse and JSON Schema conformance; bundle, generator, and validator tests are presented as scoped observations.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No external registry reliability or consumer compatibility is inferred from local reachability.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed progression from semantic extraction through scope, naming, typed namespaces, identity, composition, direction, unions, recursion, graph analysis, bundling, registries, tests, and evolution.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed exact $defs/$id boundaries, OpenAPI component types, allOf and unevaluatedProperties behavior, URI registries, locks, recursive tool limits, graph metrics, bundling equivalence, code generation, and high-fan-in rollout.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed first-principles semantic reuse, two annotated data fragments, one corrected executable graph audit, ten distinct examples, and five exercises progressing from extraction decisions to registry and dependency governance.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
